label: conj:kashaev-volume-conjecture
title: Kashaev volume conjecture (axiomatised as Lean class)
html:
Superseded. The scalar substrate density \rho_q = 1/\hbar_q^2 used below is the structurally-wrong leading-order ansatz; the operator-valued form supersedes it (mass-endomorphism-tower); the canonical replacement is the operator-valued A^\lambda_{\mu, \nu}(I) graded expansion prop:rho-k-graded-expansion.

The Kashaev volume conjecture (KVC) asserts that, for every hyperbolic knot K \subseteq S^3, the Kashaev limit of the colored Jones polynomial computes the hyperbolic volume of the complement,

  \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(S^3 \setminus K)
  \;=\;
  2\pi \cdot \lim_{N \to \infty}
  \frac{\log \lvert J_N(K)\rvert}{N},
  \qquad
  J_N(K)\big\vert_{q = \exp(2\pi i / N)},

with the convention that the right-hand side vanishes when K is not hyperbolic. KVC was conjectured by Kashaev [kashaev1997] and reformulated in terms of the colored Jones polynomial by Murakami–Murakami [murakami-murakami2001]. It is open in general (proved only for specific families: the figure-eight knot, certain torus and pretzel knots, etc.).

Inside QOU, KVC is the consistency statement that the archimedean realisation functor \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} = \pi_\infty \circ \tau (archimedean realization functor) applied to the algebraic quantum volume (algebraic quantum volume) recovers the hyperbolic volume; this is the content of the per-block Kashaev as archimedean realization remark.

Lean axiomatisation

KVC is encoded in Lean as a typeclass

class VolumeConjecture (q : ℝ) where
  hypVolume       : Braid → ℝ
  kashaevLimit    : Braid → ℝ
  kvc_holds       : ∀ β, hypVolume β = kashaevLimit β
  hypVolume_nonneg : ∀ β, 0 ≤ hypVolume β

The class fields encode the conjectural identification of hyperbolic volume with the Kashaev limit. Any instance of VolumeConjecture is conjecture-bearing: the kvc_holds field plays the role of sorry, but as an axiomatised class field rather than a tactic failure. Downstream results that depend on KVC take it as an [VolumeConjecture q] typeclass argument and are then fully verified by Lean — the only unproved input is the class instance.

This is the same pattern used for MassEvaluation in mass endomorphism tower: the canonical computation is axiomatised so that the algebraic tower identities are machine-checked.

Rationale for a class rather than an axiom

Three reasons:

  1. Locality. A typeclass instance can be supplied per knot family (figure-eight, torus, etc.) where KVC is actually proved; downstream theorems then specialise to verified ground.

  2. Compositionality. A bridge theorem of the form \Phi_q(V_S) = \rho_q \cdot \mathrm{Vol}(K_S) depends only on KVC restricted to K_S; the typeclass scope makes that dependency visible in the type signature.

  3. No global axiom pollution. Mathlib's axiom audit (#print axioms) records typeclass dependencies but does not flag them as global axioms; the conditional nature of every downstream result is preserved.

The conjecture itself remains open at the level of \pi_0 — no claim of proof is made by introducing the class.

Motivic perspective

KVC is, in motivic language, a regulator statement: the hyperbolic volume of S^3 \setminus K is the image of a class in the Bloch group \mathcal{B}(\mathbb{C}) under the Borel/Beilinson regulator r_\infty, and the colored Jones polynomial at q = \exp(2\pi i / N) is the q-deformed avatar of that class [zagier1986, neumann-zagier1985]. The QOU recasting frames \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} = \pi_\infty \circ \tau as the archimedean realisation functor on the algebraic data \Phi_q(\lvert V_S\rvert) — a class in the quantum Bloch group (quantum Bloch group) — landing in \mathbb{R} as the hyperbolic volume of the corresponding Φ_q-piece. KVC, in this presentation, is the assertion that the q-deformed regulator agrees with the classical one in the Kashaev limit.
